entities.name: Moon of Innistrad
entities.description: Innistrad's silver moon, a source of hope and misfortune that influences seasons, werewolves and vampires.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose moon shapes its seasons and horrors.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The Archangel associated with the moon and the heron symbol.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who charted the moon's forces over many cycles.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan who let herself be sealed in the moon.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: The planeswalker to whom Emrakul spoke before being sealed.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire from whom the Moonsilver Key was recovered.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Assisted in recovering the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Arlinn
entities.description: Planeswalker who recovered the Moonsilver Key with the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Planeswalker band who helped end the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Celestus
entities.description: Ancient device that roared back to life when the Moonsilver Key and Sungold Lock were joined.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: Key recovered from Olivia Voldaren to banish the Eternal Night.

entities.name: Eternal Night
entities.description: Period during which the moon was held in place by ancient magic.

events.summary: Emrakul willingly lets herself be sealed in Innistrad's moon.
events.quote: The Eldrazi titan Emrakul willingly let herself be sealed in Innistrad's moon

events.summary: Arlinn and the Gatewatch recover the Moonsilver Key from Olivia Voldaren with Sorin's help.
events.quote: Arlinn and the Gatewatch managed to recover the Moonsilver Key from Olivia Voldaren

events.summary: The Moonsilver Key and Sungold Lock are joined, the Celestus awakens, and the Eternal Night ends.
events.quote: The balance between night and day was restored.

relations.note: Moon associated with Avacyn's divine power.
relations.quote: the moon has been associated with the divine power of the Archangel Avacyn
Emrakul's presence in the moon gives rise to a strange visual phenomenon
